memo:
**New Method for Future-Only Pre-Kickoff Research**: Implement a "Dynamic Contextual Modeling" approach. This technique should incorporate not just historical performance data but also real-time factors like player injuries, weather conditions, and match context (e.g., rivalry status, tournament stakes). By dynamically adjusting models pre-kickoff, this method can provide more nuanced probative insights into game outcomes.

**Falsifiable Validation Test**: To validate this model, conduct a "Performance Comparison Test" against a static baseline model that uses only historical data. Analyze a sample of fixtures over a defined period, ensuring that both models make predictions prior to kickoff. The null hypothesis will be that there is no significant difference in hit rates between the two models. If the dynamic model significantly outperforms the static model (p < 0.05), it would support its efficacy; otherwise, it will indicate no performance advantage.
